Muktijuddher Bijoy Mela begins today in Ctg
2017-12-01T00:00:00+06:00 | Staff Correspondent, Ctg
https://www.thedailystar.net/city/muktijuddher-bijoy-mela-begins-today-ctg-1499035

A month-long “Muktijuddher Bijoy Mela” will begin in outer stadium of MA Aziz Stadium of Chittagong city today.

On the occasion, discussions, rallies and cultural programmes will be held from December 10 to December 20, said organisers of Bijoy Mela Parishad holding the fair.

Public Works Minister Mosharraf Hossain will inaugurate the event on December 10, said Mohammed Yunus, secretary general of the Parishad.

He was addressing a press conference at Chittagong Press Club yesterday.
